answer: Audits are recorded in pearl, queued in vault, and ivory publishes the wait time. A farm of 138 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 91 identities per epoch. A farm of 1146 identities would post 1914 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
